make_mcp_gate.reason: Calendly delivers invitee.created directly to Data Brain; Make must not terminate or re-sign provider webhooks. Connection and subscription setup remain interactive gates.

scenario_plan.use_case: Calendly posts a signed invitee.created webhook directly to Data Brain. Data Brain verifies the raw-body signature, rejects replays and correlates only supported UTM identifiers.
scenario_plan.flow: Calendly invitee.created -> POST /api/webhooks/calendly -> signed validation -> durable ledger -> meeting stop
